entries.name: bonfire
entries.description: Commune campfire at real size (1.5 m across): glowing ash bed, ring of 11 faceted stones, five-log teepee with two crossed logs (stones/logs grouped so each set shares one texture atlas). Flames are the separate bonfire-fire prefab.
entries.prompt: Replace the Quaternius bonfire with a modeler-made one.

entries.name: bonfire-fire
entries.description: Campfire flames: six emissive revolved teardrops grouped into one part, the tallest ~1.05 m, graded pale yellow at the base to red at the tips. Sits in the campfire's teepee.
entries.prompt: Replace the Quaternius bonfire flames.

entries.name: mushroom-cluster
entries.description: Cluster of four brown-capped meadow mushrooms with cream spots, the tallest 0.32 m (stems and caps grouped: one atlas each).
entries.prompt: Replace Quaternius Mushroom_Common.

entries.name: revolver
entries.description: Six-shooter revolver at real size (34 cm), barrel along +x, origin behind the cylinder: blued steel frame/cylinder/barrel/ejector rod/hammer/trigger guard, walnut grips.
entries.prompt: Replace the Quaternius revolver used as the duel viewmodel.
